cards.name: Coming In Hot
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn. Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)

cards.name: Emergency Powers
cards.oracleText:
Each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library, then draws seven cards. Exile Emergency Powers.
Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, you may put a permanent card with mana value 7 or less from your hand onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Engineered Might
cards.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Target creature gets +5/+5 and gains trample until end of turn.
• Creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain vigilance until end of turn.

cards.name: Garenbrig Carver // Shield's Might
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. (Then exile this card. You may cast the creature later from exile.)

cards.name: Gaea's Might
cards.oracleText: Domain — Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each basic land type among lands you control.

cards.name: Kodama's Might
cards.oracleText:
Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
Splice onto Arcane {G} (As you cast an Arcane spell, you may reveal this card from your hand and pay its splice cost. If you do, add this card's effects to that spell.)

cards.name: Might of Murasa
cards.oracleText:
Kicker {2}{G} (You may pay an additional {2}{G} as you cast this spell.)
Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets +5/+5 until end of turn instead.

cards.name: Might of the Old Ways
cards.oracleText:
Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
Coven — Then if you control three or more creatures with different powers, draw a card.

cards.name: Serum Powder
cards.oracleText:
{T}: Add {C}.
Any time you could mulligan and this card is in your hand, you may exile all the cards from your hand, then draw that many cards. (You can do this in addition to taking mulligans.)

cards.name: Power of Fire
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has "{T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target."

cards.name: Power of Persuasion
cards.oracleText:
Choose target creature an opponent controls, then roll a d20.
1—9 | Return it to its owner's hand.
10—19 | Its owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
20 | Gain control of it until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: Soul's Might
cards.oracleText: Put X +1/+1 counters on target creature, where X is that creature's power.
